reviews.title: I really have liked all of them so far
Inconsistent answers in Slots section
reviews.text: Sometimes shower is in the morning and sometimes it’s at night. That’s just an example. I don’t like the slots section at all. It has other inconsistent answers also and some answers that don’t even make sense. The rest of the game is OK.

reviews.title: Enjoyed but, too many ads.
reviews.text: I really liked this game, questions are good and the variety of games keep your mind sharp. Once again, the ads interrupting the game is a big downfall. I refuse to pay an extortion fee just to have ad free.

reviews.title: The City of Ads
reviews.text: Way too much ads. I’m only on level 10 and see soo much on like to spin a wheel for some odd reason and there’s an award for the day.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: Way too ads, even during a game. Deleting

reviews.title: Like the game
reviews.text: But to many ads so I will be deleting the game soon!
